what_is_it.explanation: ShellRS is a cross-platform desktop application that combines Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, a WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP browser, and SSH port forwarding. It is written in Rust and uses the GPU-accelerated GPUI framework, eliminating Electron and JVM dependencies. It also provides a CLI and agent skills for AI assistants to securely run commands and transfer files.
what_is_it.one_line: A high-performance native SSH client, terminal emulator, and SFTP browser built in Rust with GPUI.
